question: Repeat diagnosis documentation in the first postpartum year and months 7-12 by payer at delivery
cohort: Pregnancy-group members of the original 175505 matched pairs, with delivery admissions in 2023
first_record: Same condition-specific pair history exclusion during days -449 through -85; woman's first primary record during days -84 through 139 must be on days 0 through 139. Her partner's pre-index record does not exclude her from this descriptive follow-up.
delivery_date: First delivery-coded claim within the linked hospitalization, a proxy for actual delivery date
first_year: Day after delivery-hospitalization discharge through the calendar anniversary of the delivery-date proxy, inclusive
months_7_12: Day after the six-calendar-month anniversary of the delivery-date proxy through the one-calendar-year anniversary, inclusive; also must be after discharge
eligibility: Source dates cover entire observation period and a continuous medical-enrollment span covers discharge through calendar-year anniversary. Identical denominator for both windows.
payer: Commercial or managed Medicaid measured at delivery discharge; payer can change postpartum
outcome: At least one diagnosis matching the same primary condition definition in any setting; no E/M, prescription, or procedure requirement
uncertainty: Wilson pointwise 95% confidence intervals; independent Newcombe intervals for managed Medicaid minus commercial; exploratory, no multiplicity adjustment
interpretation: Repeat documentation, not confirmed continuing treatment; sickle cell trait is not a treatment-continuation outcome
